description: Create a new task or action item. Use this to capture commitments, reminders, or to-do items. Link it to a thread (the meetings of one project) or a company, the people it involves (their IDs) and the meeting it came from, so it shows on those pages.

committedBy.description: Optional: "user" when the user owes it (the default), "other" for a promise someone made the user. Left out, assignees decide

company.description: Optional: the company it is for, as one of the user's people has it

otherPerson.description: Optional, with committedBy "other": the name of the person who owes it

otherPersonId.description: Optional, with committedBy "other": the ID of the person who owes it (from list_people)

personIds.description: Optional: IDs of the people it involves (from list_people)

sourceMemoryId.description: Optional: the ID of the meeting it came from (from list_memories)

thread.description: Optional: the thread (project) it belongs to: a meeting ID in it, the name the user gave the thread, or the title its meetings share

name: create_task
